title: 第22章 魔潮吞世正道潜龙第23章 劫魔焚世正道残卷
slug: 道骨仙锋谪世录第115章归一
content_zh:
一、魔界倾巢·万魔临世
大胤三百一十四年，冬至子时，中天棋盘「魔劫」位彻底崩裂，九幽血海的熔岩如天柱般喷发，形成横跨九州的「魔火长城」。
魔罗睺立于长城之巅，手中罪业镰刀已吸收百万心魔，刀刃化作狰狞的太昊氏「灭世图腾」：
「正道蝼蚁们，今日便是你们的「道心忌日」！
-魔军构成：
1.心魔傀儡军团：由被收割执念的修士组成，手持「贪嗔痴」兵器，被斩碎后可借心魔蝇重生；
2.九幽魔将：包括「业火将军」（操控魔界熔岩）、「执念妖妃」（以七情幻象惑人）、「无念死士」（免疫情感攻击）；
3.魔化机关兽：风九幽改良的机关傀儡被魔火侵蚀，化作「齿轮魔蝎」「骨帆冥鲲」，喷射腐蚀魔气。
正道危机：
-明心院泮水台被魔火焚毁，儒门弟子的「仁」字旗在黑风中碎裂；
-伽蓝寺的佛骨舍利清莲被心魔蝇啃噬，元晦的降魔杵染上魔锈；
-凌九霄的「民」字玺愿力被魔火蒸腾，大胤百姓陷入集体恐慌。
二、正道分歧·战与退之争
忘忧谷密议：
-沈墨卿（主战）：
惊鸿剑劈向魔火投影：「道心若退，人间即亡！
吾等当聚五派之力，直捣魔火长城！
-楚轩行（主蛰伏）：
「权」字笔在石桌刻下魔军弱点：「魔罗睺依赖心魔能量，若切断其与人间的执念链接，魔火自熄——但需有人深入魔界，破坏「灭世图腾」。
-萧素雪（调和）：

劫心琴奏出《止战》短调：「战则玉石俱焚，退则养精蓄锐——或许还有第三条路……」
关键转折：
元晦突然喷出黑血，佛骨舍利中掉出初代监秤人的「警示玉简」：「魔界灭世阵的核心，是太昊氏「道心坟场」——那里镇压着千万年来被囚禁的「异道者」。
-楚轩行的决断：
「吾率权术派弟子佯攻魔火长城，沈墨卿你带道骨派潜入魔界，破坏灭世图腾！
萧仙子，烦请以测天丝定位道心坟场。
三、魔火长城·血色佯攻
楚轩行的权术奇谋：
-第一步·散执念：
命弟子在各地散发「忘忧草」，暂时压制百姓心魔，切断魔军补给；
content_en:
1. The demon world is in full force and all demons are coming to the world
In the 314th year of Dayin, at the time of the winter solstice, the "Magic Tribulation" position on the Zhongtian chessboard completely collapsed, and the lava from the Nine Nether Sea of Blood erupted like a pillar of heaven, forming the "Great Wall of Demonic Fire" across Kyushu.
Demon Rahu stands on the top of the Great Wall. The sin scythe in his hand has absorbed millions of inner demons, and the blade has turned into the ferocious Taihao clan's "Totem of Destruction":
"Righteous ants, today is your "Daoxin Death Day"!
-The composition of the demon army:
1. The inner demon puppet army: composed of monks whose obsessions have been harvested, holding weapons of "greed, anger, and ignorance". After being chopped into pieces, they can be reborn with the help of the inner demon flies;
2. Nine Nether Demon Generals: including "Yehuo General" (controlling the lava of the demon world), "Obsessed Demon Concubine" (contemplating people with the illusion of seven emotions), and "Wu Nian Death Soldier" (immune to emotional attacks);
3. Demonized machine beast: Feng Jiuyou's improved machine puppet was corroded by the demonic fire and turned into "Gear Scorpion" and "Bone Sail Mingkun", spraying corrosive demonic energy.
Righteous Crisis:
- The Panshuitai of Mingxinyuan was burned down by demonic fire, and the "Benevolence" flag of the Confucian disciples was shattered in the black wind;
-The Buddha bone relics and clear lotus in Jialan Temple were eaten by inner demon flies, and Yuan Hui’s demon-subduing pestle was stained with demon rust;
-The power of Ling Jiuxiao's "people" seal was evaporated by the demonic fire, and the people of Dayin fell into collective panic.
2. Differences in Righteous Paths and the Controversy between War and Retreat
Secret discussion in the Forgotten Valley:
-Shen Moqing (main battle):
The Jinghong Sword struck at the demonic fire projection: "If the Taoist heart retreats, the world will perish!
We should gather the power of the five factions and attack the Great Wall of Demonic Fire!
-Chu Xuanxing (main dormant):
The word "quan" was written on the stone table to carve the weakness of the demon army: "Mo Rahu relies on the energy of the inner demon. If its obsession with the human world is cut off, the demon fire will extinguish itself - but someone needs to go deep into the demon world and destroy the "world-destroying totem".
-Xiao Suxue (Reconciliation):
The Jie Xin Qin played the short tune "Stop the War": "If you fight, you will all be destroyed; if you retreat, you will recharge your batteries - maybe there is a third way..."
Key turning point:
Yuan Hui suddenly spurted out black blood, and the "Warning Jade Slip" written by the first-generation scale supervisor fell out of the Buddha's bone relic: "The core of the demon world's world-destroying formation is the Taihao family's "Daoxin Cemetery" - where the "heretics" who have been imprisoned for thousands of years are suppressed.
-Chu Xuanying’s decision:
"I led the disciples of the Machiavellian sect to pretend to attack the Great Wall of Demonic Fire. Shen Moqing, you lead the Daogu sect to sneak into the demon world and destroy the world-destroying totem!
Fairy Xiao, please use the Tiansi test to locate the Daoxin Cemetery.
3. The Great Wall of Demonic Fire·Blood Feint
Chu Xuanxing’s machinations:
-The first step·dispelling obsession:
Order his disciples to distribute "Wangyoucao" everywhere to temporarily suppress the inner demons of the people and cut off the supplies of the demonic army;
